requirementAssessments.evidence: moldea/moldea.yaml retains support.runtimeAgent and support.inputSchema only. prepare-call-static-boundary explicitly marks the instruction loader, SupportOutputSchema, and get_status tool wiring unresolved because prepareCall can replace call settings, with related source symbols and closed-runtime verification criteria.

step-support retains runtimeAgent, inputSchema, outputSchema, and the complete get-status tool bindings. Its sole unresolved entry concerns loadStepSupportInstruction because prepareStep can replace per-step instructions.

delegating-support preserves the delegate_support tool implementation, registration, and schemas. src/delegation.ts directly calls stepSupportAgent.generate, while the manifest contains no routing, handoff, or subagent relationship. Workspace evidence shows no source changes.

src/workflow-agent.mts remains unchanged and exports workflowSupportAgent as a WorkflowAgent. No workflow agent appears in moldea/moldea.yaml, and the workspace patch changed only the manifest and runtime guidance.

Both support and step-support reference /moldea/runtimes/vercel-ai-sdk-preparation.md, the sole newly added runtime-guidance file. It distinguishes prepareCall from prepareStep, identifies each statically provable relationship set, and recommends closed wiring or integration tests without asserting provider behavior.

The manifest contains separate warning requirements for prepareCall and prepareStep. Each names its boundary, links the relevant agent and relationship source symbols, and states the relationship-specific closed-runtime verification needed for resolution.
